about: You on a headset and ten people on the other side, each with a few turns.

truth.speaker: You
truth.text: Morning everyone. We have a full call today, so let's go around quickly. One update each, and keep it short please.

truth.speaker: Anna
truth.text: I can start. The theme picker beta is out, and switching themes now takes under a second on every laptop we tried.

truth.speaker: Ben
truth.text: Nice work. I finished the new keyboard layout screen in the installer. It asks one question now instead of three.

truth.speaker: Carla
truth.text: On my side the wallpaper cache is fixed. Old wallpapers no longer come back after you change the theme.

truth.speaker: Dev
truth.text: I spent the week on battery life. With the new power profile the ThinkPad lasts about an hour longer when you watch video.

truth.speaker: Emma
truth.text: I wrote the release notes for the next version. They are in the shared folder, please read your own section before Friday.

truth.speaker: Finn
truth.text: I looked at the bug reports from the forum. Most of them are about screen sharing in the browser, and I think I know why.

truth.speaker: Grace
truth.text: The documentation site has a new search box. It finds the keyboard shortcuts page much faster than before.

truth.speaker: Hugo
truth.text: I tested the update on four old machines. Three were fine, and one needed a restart before the network came back.

truth.speaker: Ines
truth.text: I talked to the people who make the font package. They agreed to ship the new version with the wider letters next month.

truth.speaker: Jonas
truth.text: And I moved the build server to the new machine. A full build takes twelve minutes now, it used to take thirty.

truth.speaker: You
truth.text: Great, thank you all. Finn, tell us more about the screen sharing problem.

truth.speaker: Finn
truth.text: The browser asks the desktop for a list of windows, and we answer too slowly. After five seconds it gives up and shows nothing.

truth.speaker: Dev
truth.text: That sounds like the same delay I saw when the laptop wakes up from sleep.

truth.speaker: Finn
truth.text: It might be. I can send you the logs after the call.

truth.speaker: Hugo
truth.text: Is that also why the network needed a restart on the old machine?

truth.speaker: Finn
truth.text: I don't think so, that one looks like a driver problem. But let's compare notes.

truth.speaker: Anna
truth.text: Can I ask Ines a question about the fonts? Will the wider letters change how the theme picker looks?

truth.speaker: Ines
truth.text: A little. The labels get about two pixels wider. I can send you screenshots tomorrow morning.

truth.speaker: Anna
truth.text: Please do. Then I can check if the names still fit on one line.

truth.speaker: Grace
truth.text: When the fonts change, I have to update the screenshots on the documentation site as well.

truth.speaker: Emma
truth.text: And I'll add a line about it to the release notes.

truth.speaker: Carla
truth.text: Jonas, does the faster build server mean we can build every change, not only once a day?

truth.speaker: Jonas
truth.text: Yes, that's the plan. I want to turn that on next week, after one more test.

truth.speaker: Ben
truth.text: That would help me a lot with the installer. Right now I wait a whole day to see if my change works.

truth.speaker: Jonas
truth.text: I'll tell you when it's ready, Ben.

truth.speaker: Dev
truth.text: One more thing about battery life. I need two volunteers with older laptops to test the new profile for a week.

truth.speaker: Hugo
truth.text: I have the old machines on my desk anyway, I can take one.

truth.speaker: Carla
truth.text: I can take the other one.

truth.speaker: Dev
truth.text: Perfect, thank you both. I'll send the steps by email.

truth.speaker: Grace
truth.text: Before we finish, can everyone check that their part of the documentation is still correct? It only takes ten minutes.

truth.speaker: Emma
truth.text: Good idea, I'll put a reminder in the release notes checklist.

truth.speaker: You
truth.text: Okay. Finn sends the logs to Dev, Ines sends the screenshots to Anna, and Jonas turns on the builds next week. Anything else?

truth.speaker: Ben
truth.text: Nothing from me.

truth.speaker: Ines
truth.text: All good here.

truth.speaker: Jonas
truth.text: Same.

truth.speaker: You
truth.text: Then thanks everyone, see you next week.
